description: Defines utility functions, enums, and classes for dumpstate command options and system properties in Android's dumpstate utility.

classes.name: CommandOptions
classes.description: Represents command execution options with builder pattern for setting timeout, privilege, output, and logging.

classes.name: CommandOptionsBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing CommandOptions with chained setters.

classes.name: PropertiesHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods to query system properties related to dumpstate behavior.

methods.name: Timeout
methods.description: Gets the command timeout in seconds.

methods.name: TimeoutInMs
methods.description: Gets the command timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: Always
methods.description: Checks if command should always run, even in dry-run mode.

methods.name: ShouldCloseAllFileDescriptorsOnExec
methods.description: Checks if all FDs should be closed before exec.

methods.name: PrivilegeMode
methods.description: Returns the privilege mode of the command.

methods.name: OutputMode
methods.description: Returns the output mode of the command.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Creates a builder with specified timeout in seconds.

methods.name: WithTimeoutInMs
methods.description: Creates a builder with specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: IsUserBuild
methods.description: Checks if device is running a user build.

methods.name: IsDryRun
methods.description: Checks if dumpstate is in dry-run mode.

methods.name: IsParallelRun
methods.description: Checks if parallel run is enabled.

methods.name: RunCommandToFd
methods.description: Executes a command, writes stdout to a file descriptor, and returns status.

methods.name: DumpFileToFd
methods.description: Dumps file contents into a file descriptor.
